method: Local depth-aware radial XZ warp. Original PMX31-point aperture polygon gives target. Rounded rim/throat enlargement is measured cumulatively by actual solid ray tests versus raw rim depth; the already adequate front skin is not blindly widened. Upper/lower oversized aperture receives small inward shaping. Continuous compact C2 radial/depth support, Y fixed during aperture warp; one pre-existing sliver receives a final0.000663mm Y micro-correction for shading continuity. No remeshing.

postprocess.method: Local positive projected-area constraint for one pre-existing extremely slender inner-upper triangle. Three vertex XZ positions corrected by minimum-norm gradient steps; Y remains exact. No hole curve retargeting or remeshing.

tangent_finish.method: Single middle vertex of sliver9861 aligned with the smooth adjacent-face area-weighted normal, constrained to the plane containing the untouched two end vertices. Original triangle area retained.
